config.status: development starting parameters; not frozen A3 criteria
config.test_policy: masks and pixel counts only; box cached ghost diagnosis only; no method evaluation

method: candidate-time colors from four nearest non-target views; mesh geometry fixed
confirmation_rule: >=1000 dynamic-region pixels, >=5% relative nonlocal minimum margin, best times across 3 views within two frames
limitations: textureless mesh precludes meaningful raw vertex-color RGB matching
view-dependent reflectance and unmodelled motion can change reprojection error
candidate colors are nuisance variables; this probe alone cannot certify mesh correctness

fixed_appearance_check.method: fixed O1 center image, colors fitted at the independently selected frame1; compare to all50 target frames
fixed_appearance_check.independence: secondary appearance check, not independent temporal selection because colors were fitted at frame1
